# gitmoap_catalog_scorecard_results (Data Source)

List a scorecard's results, worst state first. Returns one result per service and check, failing first, then stale, expired, unknown, passing and not applicable. Beside the page sits a summary over the whole scorecard, never just the page: how many services reach each level and how many are not scored at all. Filter by `state`, `check_key` or `service_id`; page with `limit` and `next_token`.

The token needs `catalog:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scorecard_id` (String) The scorecard's id

### Optional

- `check_key` (String) Filter to one check
- `service_id` (String) Filter to one service. `summary` is unaffected and stays scorecard-wide, so a per-service count is folded from `items` — which with this filter is that service's complete result set
- `state` (String) Filter to one check state

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `summary` (Attributes) How many services a scorecard could score, and how many it could not. External services have
nothing to measure, so they are counted separately rather than mixed into the totals. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `attested_at` (String)
- `attested_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--attested_by))
- `check_key` (String)
- `evaluated_at` (String)
- `evidence_at` (String)
- `evidence_commit_sha` (String)
- `evidence_pipeline_id` (String)
- `evidence_run_id` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `flapping` (Boolean) Whether the check has changed state ten times today, after which further changes are not
recorded until tomorrow. Read it as "this check is not trustworthy": a threshold set at the
noise floor, or a test that is not deterministic.
- `observed_value` (Number)
- `scorecard_id` (String)
- `service_id` (String)
- `state` (String) What a check currently says about a service, listed worst first. `failing`: the check does not
hold. `stale`: the evidence that used to prove it no longer does. `expired`: an attestation whose
renewal window has passed. `unknown`: never evaluated. `passing`: the check holds.
`not_applicable`: the check does not apply to this service, so it does not count against it.

<a id="nestedatt--items--attested_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.attested_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.



<a id="nestedatt--summary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary`

Read-Only:

- `scored` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary--scored))
- `unscored` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary--unscored))

<a id="nestedatt--summary--scored"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary.scored`

Read-Only:

- `checks` (Attributes) How many checks are in each state. All six states are always present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary--scored--checks))
- `total` (Number)
- `unleveled` (Number) Services reaching no level at all — including every service on a scorecard with no levels.

<a id="nestedatt--summary--scored--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary.scored.checks`

Read-Only:

- `expired` (Number)
- `failing` (Number)
- `not_applicable` (Number)
- `passing` (Number)
- `stale` (Number)
- `unknown` (Number)



<a id="nestedatt--summary--unscored"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary.unscored`

Read-Only:

- `external` (Number) Services marked external, which the platform cannot measure.
- `reason` (String) Why nothing could be derived, in one phrase a page can render beside the number.
- `total` (Number)
